# Dissentry (by Lihai La)

> Community Notes for AI answers. Ask one AI model; your other models fact-check the answer and attach a dissent note only when something is factually wrong, outdated, broken, or unsafe.

- Homepage: https://dissentry.lihaila.com/
- MCP Setup Guide: https://dissentry.lihaila.com/mcp
- Hosted Cloud MCP (Streamable HTTP + OAuth 2.1): https://dissentry.lihaila.com/v1/mcp
- Official MCP Registry: io.github.Lihaila/dissentry
- Privacy Policy: https://dissentry.lihaila.com/privacy
- Terms of Service: https://dissentry.lihaila.com/terms
- Publisher: Lihai La LLC (https://lihaila.com/)
- Source code (MIT): https://github.com/Lihaila/dissentry
- npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dissentry (`npx dissentry`)

## Key Capabilities
- **Multi-model fact-checking**: `@mention` any model (Claude, GPT, Gemini, DeepSeek, Qwen, Grok, Mistral, Groq, OpenRouter, Ollama, LM Studio, or any OpenAI-compatible API). Checker models review the answer and stay silent unless they find a genuine error.
- **Built-in MCP Server (stdio & Streamable HTTP)**: Expose `dissentry_check`, `dissentry_ask`, `dissentry_list_models`, and `dissentry_trust` via `npx -y dissentry mcp` (stdio) or `http://127.0.0.1:4317/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) for Google App (Gemini Desktop), Claude Code, Cursor, Claude Desktop, Antigravity, WorkBuddy, Qwen Work / Qwen Code, and DSH (DeepSeek Harness), reusing `~/.dissentry/data.json` models, keys, and proxy settings.
- **Shared thread memory, Web Search & DeepThink**: Models in a thread share full conversation context (including sibling replies, dissent notes, and attachments), with per-model and per-message toggles for native Web Search and DeepThink extended reasoning.
- **Files, vision & Image/Audio/Video generation**: Attach images, PDFs, or text/code files for vision chat models, or `@mention` image (`qwen-image`, `wan2.7-image`, `gpt-image-1`, `imagen`), audio TTS (`qwen3-tts-flash`, `tts-1`, `gemini-tts`), and video (`wan2.7-t2v`, `sora-2`, `veo`) models directly in threads.
- **Consensus notes & underlined claims**: Disputed claims are underlined in the answer, and overlapping notes from multiple checkers merge into one consensus note.
- **Local vs. Cloud clarity & Local-only threads**: Models are labeled Local or Cloud, the composer shows before sending whether data stays local or is shared with cloud checkers, and a 1-click Local-only thread lock strictly blocks cloud models and cloud checkers across the entire thread.
- **Local-first privacy & persistence**: API keys, prompts, answers, notes, attachments, generated media, and custom profile avatars stay on your device. The local `npx dissentry` server auto-saves to `~/.dissentry/data.json` (`0600`) and auto-restores if browser data is cleared; the hosted web app supports browser persistent storage and local file auto-backup.
- **Personal trust scores & token usage**: Rate notes as right or not helpful to build personal accuracy stats per model, and inspect answering vs. checking token costs.
- **One-click image sharing**: Export any answer and its dissent notes as a 2400px card for X or team sharing.
- **Four languages**: English, 简体中文, 日本語, 한국어.
